text:
Sam: T-minus 35 to the change window airlock. Doing a quick live sweep — call out any open pins, rollback decisions, or docs gaps now.
Maria: All release notes are up in the /releases/1721 doc. No outstanding dep notes.
Cheng: Canary metrics look steady for 1.2.3 -> 1.2.4 traffic slice. No error uptick.
Priya: There is one config pin on embeddings-service (quantized v3 -> v3-q). We should decide: pin or allow fallback?
Sam: Decision matrix: if embeddings-service latency > 220ms for >5m, roll back to v3-q-stable. Otherwise keep pin unlocked. Agreed?
Maria: Agreed. I'll add a short note in the rollout log.
Cheng: ops-bot, please set the alert window for embeddings-service >220ms for 5m to page-eng-ml.
ops-bot: @Cheng alert rule created: severity=high, metric=latency_p95, threshold=220ms, window=5m, notify=#eng-oncall and @pagerduty. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: Canary run initiated on eu-west-1 (slice=5%). Logs: https://deploys.internal/runs/12345
Priya: We also need a rollback owner assigned in case the feed degrades. I'll take rollback owner for embeddings-service.
Sam: Good — Priya is rollback owner. Cheng will monitor canary dashboards and flip the pin if needed. Maria will handle public release note updates and customer comms.
Cheng: Copy. I'll run the quick check script every 60s. Snippet below for reference:
```bash
./scripts/quick-health-check.sh --service embeddings-service --window 2m
# outputs p50/p95 and error-rate
```
Maria: Quick doc carveout: customer-facing release notes should mention the optional quantized path and the potential perf tradeoff. I added a blurb in the notes.
Sam: Any outstanding migrations or DB locks?
Priya: No migrations. One pending DB index rebuild on analytics-db but it's on a restricted schedule and won't run during the change window.
Cheng: Canary CPU spike observed at +7m but mem stable; auto-scaled and smoothed. No user-facing errors.
deploy-bot: Canary health: PASS (latency_p95=188ms, errors=0.02%). Promoting to 25% in 10m unless cancelled.
Sam: Hold promotion unless Cheng + Priya give green. We'll let the 5% run to 15m minimum.
Priya: I'm watching. If embeddings-service p95 > 220ms for two consecutive checks, I will issue rollback command.
Cheng: Charts look green at +12m. No action.
Maria: Release notes updated, changelog entry tags: [embed-quant-v3], [perf-tune]. Internal ops runbook link added.
Sam: Final checklist before handover to oncall:
- rollback owner assigned (Priya)
- pin strategy decided (auto-fallback to v3-q-stable)
- alerts in place (ops-bot)
- release notes + comms (Maria)
- no blocking DB migration
- deploy-bot canary PASS
If anything changes, call it out here.
Priya: Acknowledged. Standing by.
Cheng: Acknowledged. Will call rollback if thresholds breach.
Sam: Ok moving to silent handoff in 5. Add any last-minute notes here.
Maria: Small note: post-launch doc task for support: add FAQ for customers on quantization differences.
Sam: Noted. Good job team. :tada:
